dict.string: Weekly pip-audit walker (Python dependency vulnerability scan). Cadence 604800s = 7 days. Fires on failure-to-run AND on findings>0 via walker_health ok=False. WALKER_MESSAGE_MUTES in tools/l1_pager.py is the acknowledged-finding escape valve — silence a specific CVE ID substring with an expiry date without silencing new findings. RunAtLoad TRUE so the very first load produces a baseline row immediately; StartInterval then reruns weekly. Wrapper timeout belt = 12 min (Perl SIGALRM) — pip-audit is network-bound and a wedged PyPI advisory DB read shouldn't hang the cron.
